lunch3_start.name: {name}
lunch3_start.text: *At lunch, all three gather when I open my lunchbox. Everyone knows about the weekend invitations from this morning. Seoyeon sits beside me, Dain across from me, and even Yuna drags over an empty chair from the corner where she was eating bread.*

lunch3_start_2_b.name: Dain
lunch3_start_2_b.text: *Dain picks up the rolled omelette before Yuna can. Before lifting her chopsticks, Seoyeon looks across the table.*

lunch3_meal_1.name: Dain
lunch3_meal_1.text: Oh, this is good. Have some too, President. Getting here first doesn't mean you get all of it today.

lunch3_meal_3.name: Seoyeon
lunch3_meal_3.text: I have no intention of monopolizing someone else's lunchbox. The rolled omelette gets a six.

lunch3_meal_5.name: Seoyeon
lunch3_meal_5.text: Out of ten. Six isn't bad, you know.

lunch3_meal_6.name: Yuna
lunch3_meal_6.text: *She silently reaches out with her chopsticks and takes the best-looking sausage.*

lunch3_meal_7_b.name: Yuna
lunch3_meal_7_b.text: *Yuna looks at Dain while chewing the sausage.* So the first person to grab it doesn't get to keep it.

lunch3_meal_8.name: {name}
lunch3_meal_8.text: *This time, Yuna's chopsticks head straight for the lunchbox.*

lunch3_meal_10.name: {name}
lunch3_meal_10.text: *Three pairs of chopsticks nearly meet over the last piece of rolled omelette. This is after I suggested we all share.*

lunch3_meal_10_b.name: {name}
lunch3_meal_10_b.text: *Only one last side dish remains in the center of the lunchbox, and all three pairs of chopsticks return to their places.*

lunch3_meal_10_c.name: Seoyeon
lunch3_meal_10_c.text: *Seoyeon draws back the tips of her chopsticks before the rolled omelette.*

lunch3_meal_10_d.name: Dain
lunch3_meal_10_d.text: *“All together?” Dain laughs, but doesn't pull her chair closer.*

lunch3_meal_10_e.name: Yuna
lunch3_meal_10_e.text: *Yuna gives a short nod, then folds the note she was writing and slips it into her pocket. A dot of pale-purple ink has bled at the edge, but she never hands it over.*

lunch3_choice.name: {name}
lunch3_choice.text: *I ponder who to give the last side dish to.*

lunch3_seo_skin_1.name: {name}
lunch3_seo_skin_1.text: *While eating lunch, a grain of rice sticks to my lip. Seoyeon reaches over and picks it off.*

lunch3_seo_skin_2.name: Seoyeon
lunch3_seo_skin_2.text: Be more careful when you eat in front of people.

lunch3_seo_skin_3.name: {name}
lunch3_seo_skin_3.text: *As Seoyeon pulls her hand back, she drops her chopsticks. She picks them up at once, but their tips scrape the rim of the plate.*

lunch3_seo_witness_1.name: {name}
lunch3_seo_witness_1.text: *At the classroom threshold, Dain sees Seoyeon accept the lunchbox. Her lips move without sound, and she turns back into the hall.*

lunch3_seo_witness_choice.name: {name}
lunch3_seo_witness_choice.text: *The heels of Dain's sneakers disappear around the corner.*
choices: It’d be more fun if we invited Dain too.
I feel bad leaving Dain alone. I’ll ask her to join us.

lunch3_seo_chase_dain_1.name: Seoyeon
lunch3_seo_chase_dain_1.text: *Seoyeon sets down the lunchbox and aligns the corners of its lid.*

lunch3_give_seo_3.name: Yuna
lunch3_give_seo_3.text: *Yuna folds the bread wrapper and puts it in her bag.*

lunch3_give_dain_1.name: Dain
lunch3_give_dain_1.text: Really? Thanks! {name}, you've got good instincts.

lunch3_dain_skin_1.name: {name}
lunch3_dain_skin_1.text: *After winning the lunch bet, Dain spreads her arms and asks, “Can I hug you?” Once she has permission, she hugs me briefly, pulls away after one second, and grabs her water bottle.*

lunch3_give_dain_2.name: Seoyeon
lunch3_give_dain_2.text: Seriously? I even scored it for you.

lunch3_dain_witness_1.name: {name}
lunch3_dain_witness_1.text: *Yuna looks into the gym from the hall. When she hears Dain laugh, she presses the book cover to her chest and turns the other way. During the next break, Yuna's seat is empty.*

lunch3_give_dain_3.name: Yuna
lunch3_give_dain_3.text: *Yuna stares out the window, gripping the rolled opening of her bread wrapper.*

lunch3_yuna_skin_1.name: {name}
lunch3_yuna_skin_1.text: *Both hands are still holding the edge of the note.*

lunch3_yuna_skin_2.name: Yuna
lunch3_yuna_skin_2.text: This isn't something I wrote in the note. It's just—

lunch3_yuna_skin_3.name: {name}
lunch3_yuna_skin_3.text: *Nothing follows “just.” Only then do her fingers leave the edge of the paper.*

lunch3_give_yuna_2.name: Seoyeon
lunch3_give_yuna_2.text: I thought you were going to give it to me.

lunch3_yuna_witness_1.name: Seoyeon
lunch3_yuna_witness_1.text: I heard the library smelled like lunch. Were you with Yuna?

lunch3_yuna_witness_2.name: {name}
lunch3_yuna_witness_2.text: *Yuna taps the side of her cup once and looks at Seoyeon.*

lunch3_expose_2.name: Dain
lunch3_expose_2.text: Oh, right! {name}, we're going to the arcade this weekend. What should we eat first?

lunch3_expose_3.name: {name}
lunch3_expose_3.text: *While I choose an answer, the other two sets of chopsticks remain suspended over the lunchbox.*

lunch3_expose_4.name: {name}
lunch3_expose_4.text: *The tips of Seoyeon's chopsticks press against the edge of the lunchbox, while Yuna looks at Dain with the half-open bread wrapper in her hand.*

lunch3_expose_6.name: Seoyeon
lunch3_expose_6.text: You told me we had somewhere to go this weekend.

lunch3_expose_7.name: Dain
lunch3_expose_7.text: Wait. You asked me to hang out this weekend too.

lunch3_expose_7_b.name: {name}
lunch3_expose_7_b.text: *Yuna sets down her bread and folds the opening of the wrapper.*

lunch3_expose_10.name: {name}
lunch3_expose_10.text: *One chopstick strikes the lunchbox lid. No one picks it up.*

lunch3_expose_11.name: Yuna
lunch3_expose_11.text: That's a lie. I didn't know either.

lunch3_expose_12.name: {name}
lunch3_expose_12.text: *Three pairs of chopsticks rest over the lunchbox. At the next table, Minsu looks over, then covers his mouth with the back of his hand.*

lunch3_expose_14.name: Minsu
lunch3_expose_14.text: Dude. Have you completely lost it?

lunch3_expose_15.name: {name}
lunch3_expose_15.text: *My lips move without sound. Minsu puts down the chopsticks in his hand.*

lunch3_expose_choice.name: {name}
choices: I'm sorry. I like all of you, and I couldn't say no.
The times are different, so wouldn't it be okay?

lunch3_expose_honest_1.name: {name}
lunch3_expose_honest_1.text: I'm sorry. I like all of you, and I couldn't say no.

lunch3_expose_honest_2.name: Seoyeon
lunch3_expose_honest_2.text: You couldn't say no. That's the cruelest thing you could say, {name}.

lunch3_expose_honest_3.name: Seoyeon
lunch3_expose_honest_3.text: When you smile because you can't say no, it looks like hope to the person on the other side.

lunch3_expose_honest_4_b.name: {name}
lunch3_expose_honest_4_b.text: *Seoyeon's smile disappears as she closes the lunchbox lid. The tip of her chopsticks strikes it with a sharp click.*

lunch3_expose_honest_5.name: Seoyeon
lunch3_expose_honest_5.text: I don't do gray areas. If that's how it is, count me out.

lunch3_expose_honest_7.name: {name}
lunch3_expose_honest_7.text: *Dain's answer is shorter than usual. There is none of the excitement that normally punctuates her sentences.*

lunch3_expose_excuse_1.name: {name}
lunch3_expose_excuse_1.text: The times are different, so wouldn't it be okay?

lunch3_expose_excuse_2.name: Seoyeon
lunch3_expose_excuse_2.text: You really don't see how that's the problem?

lunch3_expose_excuse_2_b.name: Dain
lunch3_expose_excuse_2_b.text: *Dain pushes her chair back and picks up her bag.*

lunch3_expose_excuse_3.name: Dain
lunch3_expose_excuse_3.text: I need some time to think too.

lunch3_expose_excuse_4.name: Dain
lunch3_expose_excuse_4.text: *Dain stuffs the still-wrapped soboro bun into her bag.*

lunch3_expose_run_1.name: {name}
lunch3_expose_run_1.text: *I push through the classroom door. Behind me, chairs scrape all at once.*

lunch3_expose_run_2.name: {name}
lunch3_expose_run_2.text: *Behind me, chairs scrape back one after another. No one follows me out. All afternoon, I can't focus on the chalk marks on the board, and beneath my desk I keep turning my phone screen on and off.*

lunch3_share_1.name: {name}
lunch3_share_1.text: *When I suggest sharing, all three laugh. Even after the laughter stops, no one's chopsticks reach the rolled omelette first.*

lunch3_share_solo.name: {name}
lunch3_share_solo.text: *The three of them split the omelette a little at a time. No one gets up until the final halved piece is gone.*

lunch3_harem_1.name: {name}
lunch3_harem_1.text: *The three of them each take a little. Only the corners of Seoyeon's mouth lift, Dain laughs louder than usual, and Yuna never takes out the note she folded.*

lunch3_end.name: {name}
lunch3_end.text: *The bell rings and I pack up the lunchbox. No one brings up the weekend plans again.*

lunch3_give_seo_dain_mid.name: Dain
lunch3_give_seo_dain_mid.text: I wanted it, but it's fine. Save some for me next time.

lunch3_give_seo_dain_low.name: Dain
lunch3_give_seo_dain_low.text: *Dain finishes her portion and closes her water bottle.* I'm full anyway.

lunch3_give_seo_yuna_mid.name: Yuna
lunch3_give_seo_yuna_mid.text: *Yuna looks at the last side dish, then folds her bread wrapper.* Save me a little next time.

lunch3_give_seo_yuna_low.name: Yuna
lunch3_give_seo_yuna_low.text: *Yuna finishes her bread without changing her expression.*

lunch3_give_dain_seo_mid.name: Seoyeon
lunch3_give_dain_seo_mid.text: *Seoyeon puts down her chopsticks and fits the lid onto her lunchbox.* Take my score into account next time.

lunch3_give_dain_seo_low.name: Seoyeon
lunch3_give_dain_seo_low.text: *Seoyeon tidies the remaining food and only nods.*

lunch3_give_dain_yuna_mid.name: Yuna
lunch3_give_dain_yuna_mid.text: You're giving it to Dain. Ask me next time too.

lunch3_give_dain_yuna_low.name: Yuna
lunch3_give_dain_yuna_low.text: *Yuna folds her bread wrapper and takes a sip of water.*

lunch3_give_yuna_seo_mid.name: Seoyeon
lunch3_give_yuna_seo_mid.text: You're giving it to Yuna. All right.

lunch3_give_yuna_dain_mid.name: Dain
lunch3_give_yuna_dain_mid.text: Well, Yuna picked first. I'm next next time.

lunch3_give_yuna_dain_low.name: Dain
lunch3_give_yuna_dain_low.text: *Dain puts her empty water bottle in her bag.* I'm fine.
